tasks.label: build-repl
tasks.command: [ -f build/CMakeCache.txt ] || cmake -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Debug -DCMAKE_EXPORT_COMPILE_COMMANDS=ON -B build && cmake --build build --target tiny-clj-repl

tasks.label: build-tests
tasks.command: [ -f build/CMakeCache.txt ] || cmake -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Debug -DCMAKE_EXPORT_COMPILE_COMMANDS=ON -B build && cmake --build build --target unit-tests

tasks.label: ESP32: flash and monitor
tasks.command: pkill -f 'idf.py monitor' 2>/dev/null || true; pkill -f 'build_idf.sh.*monitor' 2>/dev/null || true; ./build_idf.sh --product tiny-clj --monitor
tasks.detail: Incremental IDF build (tiny + all components), no clean; then flash and monitor. Kills existing monitor so re-run needs no Restart prompt.

tasks.label: ESP32: flash and monitor (no build)
tasks.command: source ./scripts/esp_env.sh && cd esp32-idf && idf.py -DTINYCLJ_PRODUCT=tiny-clj flash && idf.py -DTINYCLJ_PRODUCT=tiny-clj monitor

tasks.label: build&run: tiny-clj (macos)
tasks.command: pkill -f '/build/tiny-clj' || true; ([ -f build/CMakeCache.txt ] || cmake -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Debug -DCMAKE_EXPORT_COMPILE_COMMANDS=ON -B build) && cmake --build build --target tiny-clj && ./build/tiny-clj

tasks.label: build&run: tiny-fx.app
tasks.command: pkill -f 'tiny-fx.app/Contents/MacOS/tiny-fx' || true; ([ -f build/CMakeCache.txt ] || cmake -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Debug -DCMAKE_EXPORT_COMPILE_COMMANDS=ON -B build) && cmake --build build --target tiny-fx && ./build/tiny-fx.app/Contents/MacOS/tiny-fx </dev/null

tasks.label: build&run: tiny-clj (esp32)
tasks.command: pkill -f 'idf.py monitor' 2>/dev/null || true; pkill -f 'build_idf.sh.*monitor' 2>/dev/null || true; ./build_idf.sh --product tiny-clj --monitor
tasks.detail: Incremental ESP32 build for the tiny-clj product, then flash and monitor.

tasks.label: build&run: tiny-fx (esp32)
tasks.command: pkill -f 'idf.py monitor' 2>/dev/null || true; pkill -f 'build_idf.sh.*monitor' 2>/dev/null || true; ./build_idf.sh --product tiny-fx --monitor
tasks.detail: Incremental ESP32 build for the tiny-fx product, then flash and monitor.

tasks.label: run-repl
tasks.command: pkill -f '/build/tiny-clj-repl' || true; ([ -f build/CMakeCache.txt ] || cmake -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Debug -DCMAKE_EXPORT_COMPILE_COMMANDS=ON -B build) && cmake --build build --target tiny-clj-repl && ./build/tiny-clj-repl

tasks.label: run-tests
tasks.command: ([ -f build/CMakeCache.txt ] || cmake -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Debug -DCMAKE_EXPORT_COMPILE_COMMANDS=ON -B build) && cmake --build build --target unit-tests && ./build/unit-tests
